target_customer: Businesses selling to buyers in new markets or industries who want protection against nonpayment
problem: Sellers expanding to new buyers face the risk that invoices go unpaid, limiting growth into new markets.
business_model: Invoice insurance plus trade credit and cross border payments, fees and premiums
product_category: Embedded trade credit insurance and B2B payments

founders.name: Derrick Wolbert
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built Hologram.com from zero to 20M ARR and led revenue through a 65M Series B.

founders.name: Q Carlson
founders.background_notes: Early designer at Flexport; VP Design at Hologram and project44.

competitors.name: Allianz Trade (Allianz Trade pay)
competitors.what: Incumbent trade credit insurer with a B2B checkout payment suite including credit insurance
competitors.traction_then: 32 percent credit insurance market share at end of 2023 per AU Group survey

competitors.name: Hokodo
competitors.what: Embedded credit and insurance at B2B checkout via API

technical_complexity.rationale: Underwriting, insurance partner integration and payments through bank partners involve regulatory and integration work more than research.

defensibility.rationale: Insurance and banking partnerships and underwriting data are hard for newcomers, but incumbents hold them already.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Allianz Trade launched an embedded checkout suite in March 2024; no source shows effect on the company.

market_need_then: Credit insurance premiums grew 6 percent in 2023 per the AU Group survey, and the sellers' nonpayment risk when entering new markets is the stated pain; no company traction data found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Bold, direct, playful, with short all caps headlines such as 'GET PAID. FOR SURE.'

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name that collides with podcasts and other 'new money' brands in search; the punchy copy is the only sourced brand asset.

pivots.from: Offshore banking and instant payments for global contractors
pivots.to: Invoice protection with insurance and trade credit
pivots.why: Not stated; a secondary profile says the earlier description changed, unconfirmed.

outcome_analysis: The company is listed as active with a team of four and has repositioned from contractor banking toward invoice insurance and trade credit. No shutdown or acquisition news was found, and funding is only visible in a paywalled aggregator, so its success or failure is not yet determinable.
notes: Funding unverified: PitchBook (partly paywalled) shows 1.5M total with Y Combinator, Olive Hill Group and Transpose Platform Management as investors; another profile says seed in March 2024 with no amount. No round recorded. Hologram employment and revenue claims come from the YC page. Pivot is inferred from the YC launch description of offshore banking versus current site and is not dated. Education not listed for any founder. Completeness pass: Seed date (March 2024) rests on a single profile with no amount. PitchBook (partly paywalled) states about 1.5M total raised with Y Combinator, Olive Hill Group and Transpose Platform Management as investors; the gap between that total and this round is unexplained. A cross-check search found no press coverage.
